letter: The short nights returned in the same familiar sequence before the Friday deadline, pulling down the measurements while the days stayed heavy with ink and writing. You found a deliberate pause on the rest day after the long walk doubled the steps and cleared the weight of the difficult conversation. Sleep stayed broken across the nineteen recorded nights, though the mood lifted when the evenings were kept quiet. The movement signal was absent for eight days of the month, yet the quiet gaps held their own steady rhythm without a score to measure them.
